title: VTC Admin Actions — Cancel — payload
description: The requester of an open administrative action withdraws it, so the parked operation never executes and the action leaves every administrator's list. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: OPTIONAL note shown to the action's approvers and kept in the audit record. Read by every administrator who can see the action.

Response.title: VTC Admin Actions — Cancel — response payload
Response.description: The action as it now stands — `status: cancelled`, `closedReason: cancelledByRequester`. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.
